title: Office front page — does it actually work?

steps.path: Dev window → Office → Home → Browse files → Documents / Office practice
steps.headline: Open "Practice memo" with Browse files, go back to Home, then rename it with its pencil — does the new name show and still open?
steps.changed: This window is a separate test copy of the app, running the new code on real files. Three practice files are waiting in Documents / Office practice; nothing else of yours is touched unless you pick it.
steps.notice: The file in your Documents folder really changes name. Its Versions (Versions button, once it's open) come along with it.
steps.risk: It's a real rename on disk — use the practice files.

steps.path: Dev window → Office → Home → right-click a practice file
steps.headline: Make a copy, then Remove from Recent — does the copy appear beside it, and does the file leave the list but stay in the folder?
steps.changed: Same window as before. Make a copy writes "… (copy).docx" in the same folder; Remove from Recent only edits the list.
steps.notice: "View in folder" in the same menu shows the copy next to the original in your file manager.

steps.path: Dev window → Office → open a practice file, type something, go back to Home
steps.headline: Rename a file open in a tab — does the tab return in place under the new name, typing kept?
steps.changed: The app saves the file, closes its tab, renames it, and puts the tab back where it was — you stay on Home.
steps.notice: The tab briefly disappears and returns with the new name.
steps.risk: If the file is open in another window, rename says "Close this file in Office first, then rename it."
